description: This Java class 'LegacyCommandResponseSenderImpl' implements a sender for command responses over AMQP in the Eclipse Hono client. It provides methods to create and send command response messages, managing the underlying AMQP link and integrating with tracing and configuration.

classes.name: LegacyCommandResponseSenderImpl
classes.description: A concrete implementation of CommandResponseSender that manages sending command responses over AMQP, extending AbstractSender, including link creation, message sending, and span management.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for the outcome, wrapping lower-level send logic.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Returns null; overridden to fulfill abstract method contract.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the fixed endpoint string used for command communication.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for the outcome, no span context.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message with a span context.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the target address string based on tenant ID and reply ID.

methods.name: sendCommandResponse
methods.description: Converts a CommandResponse into an AMQP message, sets the address, and sends, returning a future.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new CommandResponseSender with configured link and flow latency adjustment.

methods.name: startSpan
methods.description: Creates a new tracing span for forwarding command responses.
